children: President Donald Trump said Friday that he and Chinese President Xi Jinping had agreed to rename artificial intelligence “Super Intelligence,” adding a new label to Trump's ongoing effort to find what he considers a more accurate name for the technology.

In a Truth Social post, Trump said Xi “seemed to like” calling the “poorly and inaccurately named Artificial Intelligence” by what he described as a “far more accurate and important name, SUPER INTELLIGENCE.” Trump added that "everyone" had agreed to the new name.

The post followed Trump's effort to solicit suggestions from his Truth Social community for a more “elegant and accurate” description of AI. The three choices he put forward were superior intelligence, extreme intelligence, and supreme intelligence.
Trump's latest comments also come against the backdrop of his broader push to promote AI development. He has previously described concerns about AI threatening humanity as a “hoax.

title: Trump says Xi backs renaming AI ‘Super Intelligence’
